name: Structural Dynamics, Advanced Vibrations & Rotordynamics
summary: Advanced vibration topics for real machines and structures: continuous and random vibration, nonlinear behaviour, rotordynamics, vibration control and condition monitoring.

topics.name: Vibration of plates and other continuous systems (analytical and numerical)
Finite-element structural dynamics and model reduction
Random vibration: power spectral density and response of linear systems
Nonlinear vibrations: Duffing oscillator, jump phenomena and limit cycles
Rotordynamics: critical speeds, whirl, Campbell diagrams, bearing and seal effects
Passive, semi-active and active vibration control; tuned mass dampers
Machine condition monitoring and vibration-based fault diagnosis
Shock and impact response; shock isolation
